hooks.command: docs=$(git diff --cached --name-only -- ':(glob)docs/verification/**/*.md'); if [ -n "$docs" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$docs" | xargs -I{} aec run-script skill:playwright-test-generator sync-tests.js {} && aec run-script skill:playwright-test-generator preflight.sh; fi
hooks.description: Before commit, if any verification docs are staged, sync/regenerate playwright tests for each and then run preflight. A commit that stages no verification docs is a no-op.
After verification doc changes, sync the manifest for the edited doc (path read from the hook payload on stdin).
